content2.content: Notifications are messages that appear outside of your app's UI to provide reminders, communication from other people, or other timely information from your app.

content4.content: They are a key channel for user engagement and retention, allowing you to bring users back to your app.

content6.content: Users can tap a notification to open the app or perform an action directly from the notification (e.g., reply to a message).

content8.content: Notifications bridge the gap between your app and the user when they are not actively using it.
